# GuruFocus

> > GuruFocus provides comprehensive stock market research, financial data, and investment analysis tools for value investors following Warren Buffett-style strategies.

The platform offers proprietary screeners, real-time financial data, valuation metrics like the Buffett Indicator and Shiller P/E, DCF calculators, guru portfolio tracking, and insider trade monitoring. GuruFocus serves individual investors and institutions with tools accessible via web, Excel Add-In, Google Sheets Add-on, mobile apps, and Data API.

## Key Topics

- All-In-One Screener
- Stock market research
- Investment tools
- Financial data
- Guru tracking
- DCF Calculator
- Buffett Indicator
- Shiller P/E
- Insider trades
- Market valuation
- Excel Add-In
- Google Sheets Add-on
- Data API
- Manual of Stocks
- Value investing

## Main Platform

- [GuruFocus Homepage](https://www.gurufocus.com/): Main platform for stock market research with screeners, financial data tools, and value investing resources
